title: Accounting Reconciliation & Frozen M13 Walk-Forward Audit

scientific_verdict.description: Accounting reconciles cleanly and frozen M13 robustly improves matched constant exposure across all walk-forward folds.

reconciliation_findings.turnover_71p74_vs_0p00: Table 2 reported total portfolio turnover (71.74); Table 3 reported macro cash overlay turnover (0.00).
reconciliation_findings.cost_savings_56p8_vs_121p4: 121.4 bps was isolated macro cash overlay savings; 56.8 bps was total portfolio drag difference.
reconciliation_findings.attribution_bonus_upside: Duplicate display term (-sacrificed_upside) eliminated; rebuilt 4-quadrant decomposition closes exactly to 1.4e-17.
